errors.evidence: The chart is a nested donut chart with two concentric rings, not a simple pie chart. This description misrepresents its fundamental structure.
The chart contains 4 slices in the inner ring and 16 slices in the outer ring, for a total of 20 slices, not ten.
The chart uses various shades of blue and gray. There is no pink color in the chart.

errors.text_span: The "Perception Layer" represents the largest section of the pie chart
errors.evidence: The "Perception Layer" is 40.4%, while the "Semantic Layer" is 41.2%, making the Semantic Layer the largest section, not the Perception Layer.

errors.text_span: The segments are visually ordered with generally larger segments appearing towards the right side of the chart, and smaller segments towards the left.
errors.evidence: The segments are not ordered by size. For example, the largest slice ("Semantic Layer", 41.2%) is on the right, but the second-largest ("Perception Layer", 40.4%) is on the left, and the smallest ("Signal Layer", 4.3%) is adjacent to the largest.

The description fails to mention the hierarchical structure of the chart, which consists of an inner ring of four 'Layers' and an outer ring of sub-category 'Analyses'. It incorrectly treats some labels from both rings as a single flat list.

The enumeration of slices is incomplete and mixes categories from the inner and outer rings. It omits several labels from the outer ring: "Content Analysis", "Audio Difference Analysis", "Anomaly Detection", and "Asthetic Analysis".
The chart does not have a legend. All labels are placed directly on the chart segments.
